subject.title: feat: Add local Codex Workspaces analytics

question: After the foundation lands, should an unset dedicated Workspaces setting inherit the existing local cost-usage preference, with an explicit Workspaces setting taking precedence?
rationale: This is a new user-facing preference default rather than a mechanically determined bug fix, and it affects upgrade behavior for existing local-cost users.

options.title: Approve staged inheritance
options.body: Keep existing local-cost users enabled by inheritance until they explicitly set the dedicated Workspaces preference, then rebase the UI-only branch with focused upgrade coverage.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Make Workspaces disabled until users enable its dedicated preference, accepting lower automatic discovery in exchange for a stricter new-feature boundary.

options.title: Defer the feature default
options.body: Keep the foundation review independent and postpone the UI preference behavior until a narrower product proposal is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve staged inheritance
recommendation.body: Keep existing local-cost users enabled by inheritance until they explicitly set the dedicated Workspaces preference, then rebase the UI-only branch with focused upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested choice sets the product default and upgrade behavior for this repository-owned application surface.
